documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement On Opening Of New Showroom
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Ltd reported its Q1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong revenue growth driven by robust consumer demand and retail segment expansion. Management discussed upcoming store launches in Surat, Rajkot, Gandhinagar, and Maninagar scheduled for the upcoming quarters alongside ongoing marketing investments. The company also outlined its strategic shift toward enhancing retail contribution, scaling up B2C operations, and adopting Gold Metal Loans for inventory hedging over the long term. Capacity utilization, margin components, and segment performance across wholesale and retail were also addressed during the earnings call. RBZ Jewellers Ltd released its earnings presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting operational revenue of INR 1,208 million and PAT of INR 91 million.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand outlook for Q2 is good and promising.
demand_outlook.quote: And the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2, as we are approaching.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that revenue growth was driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they continue to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the growth momentum during the quarter was supported by festive demand, particularly during the Akshay Tritiya season.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth momentum was supported by festive demand, particularly during Akshay Tritiya season.

capex_expansion.claim: Surat store is slated for launch in Quarter 2, while Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar stores will launch in Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3. And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself.

capex_expansion.claim: Large format stores feature a carpet area of around 10,000 square feet, and mid-format stores have a carpet area of 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area.

capex_expansion.claim: Inventory deployment is typically INR125 crores to INR150 crores for large format stores and around INR50 crores for small format stores.
capex_expansion.quote: The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores. While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: The capital expenditure incurred for the Surat store is approximately INR10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

capex_expansion.claim: Retail expansion remains on track with flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to expand its retail presence in Rajkot, Surat, and Ahmedabad.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also planning to expand our retail presence in Rajkot, Surat and Ahmedabad as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Surat and Rajkot showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 stood at INR121 crores, registering a 60% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter under review, revenue from operations stood at INR121 crores registering a strong growth of 60% Y-o-Y with a revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter, driven by robust consumer demand, higher jewellery sales and strengthening brand recall.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 was INR18 crores with an EBITDA margin of 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter was INR9 crores, translating to a PAT margin of 7.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Amortization of lease assets stands at INR76 lakhs and lease liabilities impact at INR115 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: The amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: For financial year 2026, EBITDA margins improved to 14.44% with an expansion of 233 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: For the financial year 2026, revenue from operations stood at INR637 crores, reflecting the growth of 20% year-on-year. EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

orders_capacity.claim: The total manufacturing capacity of the factory remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.

orders_capacity.claim: Factory utilization runs around 50% on an annual basis.
orders_capacity.quote: And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The company launched 730 new designs during the quarter, averaging 8 designs per day.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio,

orders_capacity.claim: Current manufacturing capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the company has a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores which is sufficient for the four stores coming in this financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Given that we have a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores. And we are yet to utilize it, which is sufficient for the four stores that is coming in this financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Management targets maintaining a debt-to-equity ratio below 1:1 by the end of the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the inventory required for each large format store in Surat and Rajkot is anticipated to be around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So inventory generally, both the stores are large format stores. We anticipate about INR125 crores to INR150 crores of inventory for each store.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that recent customs duty and import restrictions are immediate events and they are studying ground-level market and consumer reactions.
risks_headwinds.quote: So see, these are very immediate events or it has just been a few days that these all things are happening. And generally, we would take some time, let's say, a week or 2, in fact, a little bit more to understand what -- how the market and the consumers are reacting.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that capex break-even for new stores will be achieved in a year or less.
management_commitments.quote: The capex when you say about the break-even point, the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the B2B to B2C revenue mix to reach 50-50 in a year or two, and 75-25 in the long term with retail comprising 75%.
management_commitments.quote: the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

management_commitments.claim: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

management_commitments.claim: Both showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
